name: Love Triangle~Viktor's Holiday
source:
As a new couple, you and Victor should be spending time together… Instead you’re both working nonstop. Your friends have noticed and quickly convince the two of you to book a romantic holiday to a nearby island. All of your worries seem to melt away as you begin enjoying some much needed private time together…

Until you hear something rustling in your bag and find that one of the children from the foster home has stowed away in your luggage! Suddenly, you and Viktor find yourselves thrown into a web of conspiracies. With your focus now turned on exposing the truth, can you and Viktor still find time for intimacy?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.apartmentotome2]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
作为一对新情侣，你和维克多应该花时间在一起……相反，你们都在不停地工作。你的朋友已经注意到并迅速说服你们两个预订到附近岛屿的浪漫假期。当你们开始享受一些急需的私人时间时，所有的担忧似乎都消失了……

直到你听到包里有沙沙的声音，发现寄养家庭的一个孩子已经藏在你的行李里了！突然，你和维克托发现自己陷入了阴谋之网。现在你的注意力转向揭露真相，你和维克托还能抽出时间亲密吗？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.apartmentotome2]Google Play[/url]]
